Review of this head, first posted on #951 (same commits; that PR was moved here).
**Re-review of head ae03159b: no blockers. Both items from the earlier requested-changes review are addressed at this head, in my reading.** The Hub hold stands, so this is labelled `needs-maintainer`, not `merge-ready`. The PR stays a draft.

### What I checked
- **Length the cap uses.** `rotary_cap.rs` now rounds the origin-relative coordinates (`p.X - o[0]`, `sx - o[0]`) to the output step. Those are the words `wo()` writes (`fu(v - org)`), in mm and in inch. `fanuc.cps` and `doosan-dnm.cps` pass `[orgX, orgY, orgZ]`, which come from the stream's `OriginX/Y/Z` for the setup's G54-G59 slot. Rotated offsets are refused upstream (`posting_wcs_rotation.rs`), so translation is the only case to cover.
- **Posted F never over the cap.** After the cap passes, the F word that `ff()` would write is read back (`rotaryFeedPosted`: whole mm/min, or in/min at 0.01). If it is above the uncapped limit, the block takes the limit through `rotaryFeedWord`. That word floors to 0.1 mm/min or 0.001 in/min, and refuses by name when under 0.1 mm/min. A non-finite or zero limit is never taken as a cap. An F of 0 or below posts as before.
- **Units.** Inch comes from `postOptions.Units` through the existing `inch` var. There is no second conversion: the cap is computed in mm, converted once, and floored.
- **`spindleStopped()`** stays first in `onLinear` in both posts.

### Mutation checks (reverted locally, then restored)
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Cap measured on world coordinates again (no origin) | `a_work_offset_off_the_output_grid_does_not_hide_a_short_move_from_the_cap` FAILS |
| Posted-word check disabled | `a_rounded_uncapped_feed_never_posts_above_the_cap` FAILS |

### Local results (head merged with current main, clean merge, Windows debug)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app `rotary_feed_cap` | 11 passed |
| app `fourth_axis_pose` / `c_axis_unwind` | 9 / 7 passed |
| app `post_unit_word` / `program_units` | 5 / 7 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (all binaries) | all passed, 0 failed |
| clippy `camcraft-post` and `camcraft-app`, `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

No golden or snapshot changed, and no process files are touched.

### Notes (not blocking)
- The decision file and the earlier notes on the pure-rotary inch reading and the unchanged `fanuc-lathe` `fm()` rounding still apply as follow-ups.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Hub hold lifted by the maintainer (2026-11-13: "1395 looks right and can be merged"). Flagged ready on the clean review of head ae03159b; nothing was pushed after that review.
